code = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    boxes = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        boxes.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1))

    patterned = []
    for color, r0, r1, c0, c1 in boxes:
        pattern = [[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
                   for r in range(r0 + 1, r1)]
        if any(any(row) for row in pattern):
            patterned.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1, pattern))
    if not patterned:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The source is the framed object whose interior contains the pattern.
    source = patterned[0]
    sh, sw = len(source[5]), len(source[5][0])
    pattern = source[5]
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, r0, r1, c0, c1 in boxes:
        if r1 - r0 - 1 != sh or c1 - c0 - 1 != sw:
            continue
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[r0][c] = color
            out[r1][c] = color
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            out[r][c0] = color
            out[r][c1] = color
        for i in range(sh):
            for j in range(sw):
                if pattern[i][j]:
                    out[r0 + 1 + i][c0 + 1 + j] = color
    return out
'''
pdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(path), 'exec'), globals())
print('wrote',path)
